final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT translink, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior GROUP BY translink), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.translink, s1.record_count, s1.record_count - s2.avg_count AS difference FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s2.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.record_count > s2.avg_count) SELECT SUM(record_count), AVG(difference) FROM step3
